title: Gift Factory Runner
heading: Gift Factory
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Drag a gift into the basket of its colour; let go anywhere else to throw it up in the air.

1.name: The belt
1.note: Clones ride the belt: change x by the speed, every frame.

2.name: Grab and toss
2.note: Follow the mouse while the button is down; let go and the gift zigzags down.

3.name: Baskets
3.note: Which basket is under the gift? Right colour: in it goes. Wrong colour: back up.

4.name: Full baskets
4.note: Five gifts and the basket glides away to be emptied; meanwhile it is busy.

5.name: Misses
5.note: A gift that falls off the end is missed; after five the factory closes.

6.name: Faster!
6.note: Every sorted gift speeds the belt up; gold gifts fit any basket. The whole game.
